qualification.education_qualification: Degree in Architecture, Degree/Diploma in Civil/Electrical Engineering, S.S.C., ITI, H.S.S.C.
qualification.details: Architect: Degree in Architecture from recognized University, Registered with Council of Architecture. Experience: 3 years professional experience in Architectural Design. Assistant Engineer(Civil): Degree in Civil Engineering of a recognized University. Experience: 3 years experience in Construction and maintenance in Civil Engineering Works. Junior Engineer(Civil): Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/State Board. Experience: Two years experience in relevant field. Junior Engineer (Electrical): Degree or Diploma in the Electrical Engineering from recognized University/Board. Experience: Two years experience in relevant field. Supervisor: Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or H.S.S.C. with Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized Board. Experience: One years experience as draughtsman. Draughtsman: Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or H.S.S.C. with Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized Board. Experience: One years experience as draughtsman. Technician: S.S.C. with NCVT ITI Certificate in the field/trade of Electrical/Plumber. Experience: One year experience in the relevant filed. Lower Division Clerk: Higher Secondary School Certificate or equivalent. Multi Tasking Staff: Passed Secondary School Certificate Examination or ITI equivalent. Driver(LMV): Passed Secondary School Certificate Examination or ITI equivalent.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for GRB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.goa.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GRB Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age Relaxation: Age relaxation is applicable for Government servants and for candidates belonging to reserved categories in accordance with official instructions. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GRB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.goa.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Goa Rehabilitation Board (GRB) to fill various vacant positions across different departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in GRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies available for various posts including Architect, Engineers, Supervisors, Clerks, Technicians, and Multi Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form is 12 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for GRB Jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via postal or hand delivery.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under this recruitment drive is 45 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Architect post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Architect post must hold a Degree in Architecture from a recognized university and be registered with the Council of Architecture.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GRB Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates comprises a Written Examination followed by a Computer Test as per board guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form must be submitted to the Goa Rehabilitation Board, BSNL, Administrative Building, 6th Floor, Patto Plaza, Panaji Goa 403001.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by the Goa Rehabilitation Board for these positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF directly from the important links section provided in this recruitment article.
